name: Daisy Ramos
bio: Daisy is an avid iOS developer and lover of all that is tech. Most recently working on the iOS team at Citi FinTech building data-driven solutions and new features for their consumer banking app. She also actively consults for early stage companies looking to build the next big thing. Daisy holds a B.S in Computer Science from Queens College in NYC, the same college where the try! Swift NYC meetup originated. She now organizes the meetup and hosts a wide variety of technical Swift talks. She can be found on twitter as @daisyr317.
